description: Remove a post from the queue. This is a soft delete. The post moves to the Bin, and the user can restore it from there for 30 days. Posts that have already published cannot be deleted this way. A post that is going out right now is refused with publishing_now; one that got stuck while going out is refused with stuck_publishing. Always confirm with the user before calling.

post_id.description: The scheduled post id to delete.

name: sprkly_delete_scheduled_post
title: Delete a scheduled post
